easyPrerequisites: There is a land on the battlefield.
description:
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}, destroying a land, dealing 20 damage to each creature your opponents control and each planeswalker, and putting twenty +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Vigor.
Declare Twenty-Toed Toad as an attacker, triggering its second ability, causing you to win the game.
